summary: Alaska Airlines, Inc. issued $500M of 6.500% senior notes due 2031 under an indenture with U.S. Bank Trust Company, fully guaranteed by parent Alaska Air Group. The notes rank equally with existing senior debt but are effectively subordinated to secured debt. Interest is paid semiannually, with a par call date of December 1, 2030; early redemption is at the greater of par or Treasury Rate plus 50 bps. Change-of-control triggers a 101% repurchase offer. This is a routine debt financing, not a special situation. No special-situation event is present.
